task: ae.mdlite: strict Markdown subset parser (sealed Block/Inline AST) and safe HTML renderer with line/column errors, URL allow-list and nesting caps
reasoning_summary: Block parsing is line-based with a Ln(line,col) record so positions survive quote/list prefix stripping; inline parsing runs over one joined char array with per-char positions, precomputed bracket matches and next-backtick table, and a failed-closer cache to keep unclosed delimiters linear. AST is sealed interfaces rendered with exhaustive switch patterns; URLs are allow-listed and nesting is capped so hostile input raises MarkdownException.
